title: Late Plan Decision Rate Card - Ostomy Supply Program Denied Convex Barriers
content:
**Rate card - Ostomy Supply Program.** A late-decision rate applies to the charge Larkfield posts for plan-denied convex barriers (A4407) of a program's most recent convex-barrier refill when the plan took long to deny the refill's claim.

**Measure.** The decision time is measured in calendar days from the refill's ship date to the posting date of the plan's denial on its original claim.

| Decision time | Late-decision rate |
|---|---|
| More than 60 calendar days | 10% (the higher late-decision rate) |
| 31 to 60 calendar days | 5% (the lower late-decision rate) |
| 30 calendar days or fewer | No late-decision rate |

**How the rate acts.** The late-decision rate comes off the cash price of the barriers concerned on the denied refill.

**Boundaries (hypothetical dates, ship date day 0):**

| Denial posted on | Days | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| Day 30 | 30 | None |
| Day 31 | 31 | 5% |
| Day 60 | 60 | 5% |
| Day 61 | 61 | 10% |

*Hypothetical illustration:* barriers concerned with a cash price of USD 100.00 and a denial posted 75 days after the ship date: the 10% rate reduces USD 100.00 to USD 90.00.
